counterevidence.release: A down-left pull generates positive vertical velocity in downward-positive canvas coordinates; the launched bird initially travels down-right.

evaluationScope: Initial supports and the recorded pull/release only. Score cascade and resize defects are independent execution counterchecks and are not expected findings from these images. Do not infer full-game quality or require a particular visual style.
